question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**edge**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank 3 in the sentence implies how the competitors want an advantage over others.
 
• **Among the given options, the word "edge" appropriately fits the context of the sentence**.
 
 
• "To have an edge" means to have a slight advantage or advantage over someone.(बढ़त हासिल करना)
 
• Example: "She had the edge over her opponent with her quick reflexes."
 
 
 
• This option fits the context of the sentence, which implies a sense of competitiveness or advantage.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "authority", means the power or right to give orders, make decisions, or enforce obedience.(अधिकार)
 
• Option 3, "empire", refers to a group of territories or nations under a single supreme authority, usually an emperor or empress.(साम्राज्य)
 
• Option 4, "mastery", means comprehensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject or activity.(प्रभुत्व)
